description: getContact: Get detailed information about a specific contact. Requires authentication. Get the contactId from listContacts. Returns name, email, phone, organization, and address.

contactId.description: Identifier of the contact to fetch, as returned by listContacts.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getContact
